name: Shishak
bio: Shishak was king of Egypt. When Solomon sought to kill his official Jeroboam after the prophet Ahijah announced that Jeroboam would receive ten tribes of the kingdom, Jeroboam fled to Shishak's Egypt and remained there in exile until Solomon's death (1 Kings 11:40). In the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign, Shishak marched against Jerusalem and carried off the treasures of both the temple and the royal palace, including all the gold shields Solomon had made (1 Kings 14:25-26).
